options: Registry private names and secrets only, hash alone
Every leak-scan shape, subject still printed
gates.recommendation: Registry private names and secrets only, hash alone

notes: Filed by the SP-qinvdomv review (gaps 1, 2, 5). ST-vruwai2i made kbpublic.history_changes return five fields after ST-6c5xgv5a landed; kg_contrib.py:31,63,87,91,94 still unpack four, so contribute and ST-6c5xgv5a's own check fail on main. The review changed ST-6c5xgv5a gate g1: the message check reads only the registry's private names and secrets (kbcommon.leak_hits with no allowlist flags the attribution trailer's email, 116 of the last 200 commits carry it), the added lines keep every leak-scan shape; a message hit names the commit by hash only (the subject echo printed the private id).
